title: Cute Sea Animals Clipart - Summer Design
author: cachivachecreaciones
description:
60 Cute Sea Animals Friends Clipart, in PNG format without background, 12 x 12 in sized, in High Quality, easy to download. 
Dive into our Cute Sea Animals Clipart collection, featuring 60 high-quality PNG images of enchanting ocean creatures. This set showcases playful dolphins, majestic whales, charming sea lions, adorable turtles, and colorful fishes. 
Perfect for adding a splash of marine magic to print on demand, invitations, scrapbooks, educational materials, and digital projects. Each image is crafted with crisp details and vibrant colors, ensuring they’re ideal for both print and digital use. Let these delightful sea animals elevate your creative endeavors with joy and charm!
**************************************
WHAT INCLUDES?
This clipart set includes 1 Zip file with a total of 60 Sea Animals designs in PNG format with transparent background. The resolution of all the images is 300 DPI and they are watermark free.
